title: Bochner-Riesz means on the Heisenberg group
summary: We prove new $L^p$ boundedness results for Bochner-Riesz means associated with the spectral decomposition of the sub-Laplacian on the Heisenberg group $\mathbb H_n$. Our results hold for a range $1\le p\le p_n$ where $p_n\to 2$ as $n\to\infty$. As shown by the first named author in 1990 a Stein-Tomas type Fourier restriction theorem fails to hold on $\mathbb H_n$ and thus previous results based on the approach by Fefferman and Stein from the Euclidean setting only allowed to cover the cases $p=1$ and $p=\infty$.
